configuration: M3-Agent long-video QA: memory-7b-sft plus trained control-32b-rl, with an external multimodal graph. Control history is retained across retrieval rounds within each question.
sources_read: https://arxiv.org/html/2508.09736 — listed unversioned content snapshot; sections 3.3–6 and selected appendix passages (§§10–15), including Algorithm 1 and the control trajectory.

S->M.label: reported
S->M.rationale: Video/audio observations yield episodic and semantic entries that are inserted into the graph; recurring evidence updates stored representations and weights. The graph is serialized for subsequent use.

M->A.label: reported
M->A.rationale: Retrieved graph entries enter the control model's conversation context and determine further searches, answer content, and when to answer.

A->S.label: insufficient
A->S.rationale: Control directs searches of already retained graph content. Neither these searches nor the separate benchmark grader establishes control of observation acquisition, interpretation, or expected-effect sensing. No complete exclusion of that route is stated.

M->S.label: reported
M->S.rationale: Stored face and voice embeddings identify people in incoming clips. The resulting persistent identities condition interpretation and description of the current video/audio, independently of answer-time retrieval.
M->S.locator: mmagent/face_processing.py:149–185; mmagent/voice_processing.py:197–218; mmagent/videograph.py:614–670; mmagent/memory_processing_qwen.py:36–150; [paper §4.2 and appendix §10](https://arxiv.org/html/2508.09736).

A->M.label: reported
A->M.rationale: Assistant reasoning and search decisions are appended to conversation state and reused in subsequent control rounds. This is task-local retention across model/tool interactions; persistence of those decisions into the external graph or later questions is not established.

record.label: stated
record.rationale: The service retains its own search decisions in conversation history and supplies that history to later rounds of the same question; this judgment does not rely on benchmark result files.

outcome.label: stated
outcome.rationale: Search execution results, including an explicit empty-result status, are obtained after the selected search and retained for subsequent reasoning within the question.

attribution.label: stated
attribution.rationale: The reported control trajectory links an empty result to its preceding query and changes the search approach to obtain evidence for the answer. This is an in-service correction, independent of benchmark grading.
attribution.locator: [Paper appendix §14, control-32b-rl trajectory, third assistant turn; also §5.5](https://arxiv.org/html/2508.09736); m3_agent/control.py:128–131.
attribution.quote: The previous query was about his personality regarding imagination, which didn’t yield results. So I need to approach it from another angle.

revision.label: not_stated
revision.rationale: SFT/DAPO are author-run model preparation; runtime graph updates change retained evidence, while no service-written change to parameters, prompts, reusable rules, code, or harness is reported.

later_use.label: not_stated
later_use.rationale: Reported runs use trained checkpoints and updated factual memories; no run under a mechanism durably revised by the service itself is identified.

notes: Reviewed the specified QA configuration, not the illustrative household robot or prompted baselines. Functional Memory includes the explicitly reused per-question conversation buffer, so A→M and the first three steps have only within-question scope. External graph writes originate in video perception. GPT-4o benchmark scores and saved evaluation trajectories are not treated as service feedback or self-evolution. No files were modified and no model execution was performed.
